source.readme: Real camera-trap deer detection histories, 87 sites, up to 22 daily occasions, eMammal source, 2018
source.covariates: detection_covariates.csv explicitly contains simulated detection covariates; exclude from empirical ecology

qc.missing: NA is missing occasion not a nondetection
qc.require: unique site IDs, no empty all-NA sites, at least 2 observed visits per site, at least one detection and one all-zero history

model.likelihood: single-season occupancy detection history, independent Bernoulli detections conditional on latent occupied z; ψ site occupancy probability and p per-occasion detection probability constant across sites
model.fit: maximize full log-likelihood with scipy.optimize.minimize bounded ψ,p in (1e-8,1-1e-8), multistart fixed seeds, report convergence and Hessian-based uncertainty only if stable
model.baseline: naive occupied-site fraction = sites with >=1 detection / all sites
model.identification: only if at least 2 independent daily detection occasions and closure assumption
model.sensitivity: repeat fit using first 7,14,22 observed daily columns, preserve NA; no favorable subset selection

limits: Species label 'deer' per original source; no species-level taxonomy independently verified
Daily detection intervals may not be independent, site closure and sampling effort cannot be established from CSV alone
No geographic coordinates, no independent abiotic/biotic/movement variables, no EOG geometry or full BAM causal test
Real source is public third-party illustrative example, not independent confirmatory sampling
